command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes' -Method Get).node_id; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$cu='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/commands?keyword=current-configuration'; `$ru='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/commands?keyword=running-config'; `$ck=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$cu -Method Get).commands.command_key; `$rk=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ru -Method Get).commands.command_key; if(`$ck -contains 'display_current-configuration'){ `$cmd='display current-configuration' } elseif(`$rk -contains 'show_running-config'){ `$cmd='show running-config' } else { continue }; try { `$u6='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$ub='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$o6=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u6 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch 'Time:|Last configuration|Current system time' }; `$ob=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ub -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch 'Time:|Last configuration|Current system time' }; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$ob -DifferenceObject `$o6; if(`$d){ Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n+' DIFF='+`$d.Count); `$d | Select-Object -First 30 } } catch { Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n+' ERROR') } }"
